warning.titlePre: Jaguar F-Pace D300 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ300D (Ingenium) is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ300D (Ingenium) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D (Ingenium) rebuild.
Because the F-Pace D300 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the F-Pace 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ300D (Ingenium) specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
